const src = "/workspace/repos/Ludock-go-rewrite/packages/backend/src";
const { encodeTarHeader, tarPadding, tarEnd } = await import(`${src}/tar.ts`);
const { mappedArchiveHeader } = await import(`${src}/backup-storage.ts`);
const parts: Uint8Array[] = [];
parts.push(encodeTarHeader({ name: "snapshot/", type: "directory", mode: 0o755 }));
const entries = [
  { name: "snapshot/root-0/", type: "directory", size: 0, mode: 0o755, uid: 1000, gid: 1000, mtime: new Date(1700000000000) },
  { name: "snapshot/root-0/level.dat", type: "file", size: 5, mode: 0o644, uid: 4294967294, gid: 3000000000, mtime: new Date(1700000000500) },
  { name: "snapshot/root-0/" + "ü".repeat(80) + "/deep.txt", type: "file", size: 3, mode: 0o600, uid: 0, gid: 0, mtime: new Date(4102444800000) },
];
const bodies = ["hello", "abc"];
for (const [index, entry] of entries.entries()) {
  const mapped = mappedArchiveHeader(entry, entry.name);
  parts.push(encodeTarHeader(mapped));
  if (entry.type === "file") {
    const body = new TextEncoder().encode(bodies[index - 1]);
    parts.push(body, tarPadding(body.length));
  }
}
parts.push(tarEnd());
await Bun.write("out/v050-backup.tar", new Blob(parts));
